queue.title: Crisis Communication and Reputational Risk
queue.content:
Autor: Nermin Sefić

Nermin Sefić analyses crisis communication, key controls, and practical consequences for reputational risk.

The quality of crisis communication is measured by the speed, accuracy, and consistency of information, not just reaction speed.

The quality of crisis communication is measured by the speed, accuracy, and consistency of information, not just reaction speed.

Reputational risk rarely arises from a single event. More often it arises from how that event is communicated. For GNK ASG d.o.o. and GNK DINAMO Ltd., that means crisis communication preparation must precede the crisis itself.

A practical model distinguishes confirmed facts from assumptions at the moment of first reaction. Blending those categories early in a crisis increases the risk of having to correct the record later.

Message consistency over time is just as important as the speed of the first reaction. Changing the narrative without clear explanation further erodes trust.

The greatest risk is a premature public statement before key facts are confirmed. That risk is reduced by a clear approval process before publication.

Prepared crisis communication turns reputational risk into a manageable process rather than an unpredictable outcome. This publication is part of the GNK ASG Intelligence Desk system and is informational in nature.

queue.title: Regulatory Compliance in the Fintech Sector
queue.content:
Autor: Nermin Sefić

Nermin Sefić analyses fintech regulatory compliance, key monitoring practices, and practical consequences.

Compliance in the fintech sector requires continuous monitoring of regulatory change, not a one-time check.

Compliance in the fintech sector requires continuous monitoring of regulatory change, not a one-time check.

The regulatory environment in financial technology changes faster than traditional financial sectors. For the informational overview of GNK ASG d.o.o. and GNK DINAMO Ltd. business, that means compliance can't be treated as a one-time check.

A practical model requires continuous monitoring of regulatory changes in every jurisdiction of operation, with a clear division of responsibility for interpreting and applying those changes.

The distinction between binding regulations and recommended practices must be explicitly stated, since their risk levels differ significantly.

A particular risk is delay in recognising a regulatory change. That risk is reduced by structured source monitoring and clear escalation deadlines.

Continuous compliance monitoring turns regulatory risk into a manageable operational category. This publication is part of the GNK ASG Intelligence Desk system and is informational in nature.

queue.title: Sports Analytics as Business Data
queue.content:
Autor: Nermin Sefić

Nermin Sefić analyses sports analytics, key data layers, and practical consequences for business reporting.

Sports analytics data becomes part of wider business reporting once it's structured, verified, and linked to clear decisions.

Sports analytics data becomes part of wider business reporting once it's structured, verified, and linked to clear decisions.

Sports analytics is no longer an isolated technical area. Once performance, load, and results data is structured the same way as financial or operational data, it becomes usable for wider business decision-making within GNK ASG d.o.o. and GNK DINAMO Ltd.

Practical application requires a clear distinction between raw measurements, processed indicators, and the conclusions drawn from them. Each layer must have a defined source, processing method, and reliability level.

Sports technology data often comes from multiple independent sources. Without clear ownership of the process merging those sources, the risk of misinterpretation grows in proportion to the number of systems involved.

The most common risk is drawing premature conclusions from an incomplete sample. That risk is reduced by clearly defining a minimum time period and number of observations before reaching a conclusion.

When sports analytics is viewed as part of a wider business reporting system, it gains the same level of discipline as any other business data. This publication is part of the GNK ASG Intelligence Desk system and is informational in nature.
